answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a sparrow-signed claim, sealed by a velvet hash in the tundra ledger. Each epoch the tundra beacon calls 5%; the sparrow auditor replays them; a revealed claim must match its hash, one claim per key, exposing rented-key rings. Forging 1,000 identities locks 70,000 credits; each mismatch burns 70 against a 40,000-credit pool, so scale loses money. Honest agents reveal once and keep it.
